name: us24-vob-platform
description: US24 Solutions — React VOB Automation Platform. Implements the 18-file Markdown blueprint at the repository root.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* build && pnpm --filter @us24/api build && pnpm --filter @us24/web build
scripts.test: vitest run --project domain --project schemas --project api --project web
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:push && pnpm seed
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
